city_served.value: Served — one of the 24 South Carolina towns confirmed served (Brand Guide Section E)

local_context.value: Beaufort's historic district covers 304 acres and is a National Historic Landmark; nearly 70 sites in the area are on the National Register of Historic Places (older homes). 20.8% of city residents were 65 or older (Wikipedia, citing Census); Beaufort County overall: 28.4% were 65+ in 2020. The city sits 'amid a marshy estuary'; US 21 is the major hurricane evacuation route and the 1893 hurricane caused extensive destruction; humid subtropical climate, 45.02 in average annual precipitation.

neighborhoods.value: Downtown, The Point (Old Point), The Bluff, The Old Commons, Northwest Quadrant (the five historic-district neighborhoods); Pigeon Point, Higginsonville, West End, Depot, Spanish Point, Mossy Oaks, Royal Oaks, First Boulevard, Cottage Farms (Battery Creek area).
